introH2: 🏙️ What styles of stay does the Nimmanhaemin area have, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Nimmanhaemin Road is the hippest part of Chiang Mai — specialty cafes, Michelin restaurants, cocktail bars and craft shops line the whole street. Wake up, stroll out for a coffee, then shop all day without ever calling a car · the beauty of this area is that it has stays in "every style and every budget" all within walking distance of each other, from 5-star design boutiques with a bathtub set out on the balcony and all-suite hotels with rooms the size of a condo, to an Adults Only hotel down a quiet lane, a stay with its own coffee cafe, all the way to a hostel with blackout-curtain bunks for a few hundred baht · a common problem is booking on pretty photos and ending up with a room that's noisier or smaller than expected, because Nimman is lively all night and sits under a flight path · this article rounds up 10 stays in the Nimmanhaemin area we've reviewed in depth, working down from luxury boutiques to hostels — every one based on reading real guest reviews, giving both the good points and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites with direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Chiang Mai has no metro, but the whole Nimman area is walkable · calling a Grab or hopping on a red truck (songthaew) is easy and cheap · from Chiang Mai airport (CNX) into Nimman takes about 10–15 min · the main landmarks in the area: One Nimman — a plaza of cafes, souvenir shops and a small night market that many of the stays on this list reach in 1–8 min on foot · MAYA Lifestyle Shopping Center — a big mall on the corner of the Rin Kham intersection, with a cinema and food court · the main Nimmanhaemin Road and Sois 1–17 — packed with specialty cafes, northern Thai restaurants and cocktail bars · a couple of stays on the list are in the adjoining Chang Phueak area, just a few minutes by car or Grab from Nimman · the Old City and Tha Phae Gate are about a 10 min drive away, the Night Bazaar about 15 min.

toc.name: Art Mai Gallery Nimman Hotel Chiang Mai by Compass Hospitality

entries.name: U Nimman Chiang Mai
entries.badge: 📍 best location in the area · next to One Nimman
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nimman Soi 1 · next to One Nimman · 8 min walk to Maya
entries.addr: 1 Nimmanhaemin Road Lane 1, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: If you had to pick the single best-located stay in the Nimman area, the honest takes from real reviews lean fairly clearly toward U Nimman Chiang Mai · it's a 4-star boutique in the U Hotels group, set on Nimman Soi 1 right next to One Nimman — step out of the lobby and you can cross over for a coffee immediately, with Maya about an 8 min walk away · the thing many people mention most is the full 24-hour stay system and the breakfast you can eat wherever and whenever you like, paired with a rooftop infinity pool with city views · it scores 9.3 from 791 reviews, and Deluxe rooms start at 32–36 sqm, which reviews say is more spacious than expected at this price, with comfortable, clean beds · it's number one on this list for anyone who wants the best location in the liveliest part of Chiang Mai.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: plan your check-in time around your flight to make the most of the 24-hour system · if you're a light sleeper, ask for a high floor or a room not facing the street — it's much quieter on Friday and Saturday nights · and order breakfast up to the rooftop pool for a late morning at least one day.
pros: Best location, next to One Nimman — walk the whole area's cafes and shops
Full 24-hour stay system, great value and flexible on check-in/check-out times
Dine-anywhere breakfast you can have wherever and whenever · rooftop infinity pool with city views
Rooms more spacious than expected at this price, friendly and attentive staff (from the reviews)
cons: The Nimman area is lively; rooms facing the street or on lower floors pick up night noise
Air-con in some rooms doesn't get cold enough · some paintwork is starting to age with the building
Parking is limited when the hotel is full · not ideal if you're after resort-style quiet

entries.name: Akyra Manor Chiang Mai
entries.badge: 🛁 bathtub on the balcony · rooftop infinity pool
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nimman Soi 9 · walk to Nimman Road and One Nimman
entries.addr: 22/2 Nimmana Haeminda Road Soi 9, Su Thep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: If you're looking for the most luxurious, most design-forward stay on this list, Akyra Manor Chiang Mai is the answer · a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, opened in 2015 with just 30 suites, set on Nimman Soi 9 · the charm reviews talk about most is the bathtub set out on your own private balcony to soak in the warm water looking over the city, and the rooftop infinity pool paired with the RISE Rooftop Bar with its sunset happy hour and Doi Suthep views · rooms in dark, modern design tones start around 30 sqm, bringing city and resort together in one building right in the heart of Nimman · it scores 9.3 from 426 reviews, ideal for anyone who wants a luxury boutique experience in a walkable area.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: head up to RISE Rooftop Bar during happy hour for the buy-one-get-one in the early evening, the best time for the Doi Suthep view and sunset · ask for a room with a genuinely private balcony to make full use of the outdoor tub · and with only 30 rooms it fills fast in high season, so book ahead.
pros: 5-star design, a Small Luxury Hotels member, luxurious and full of character
Bathtub on your own private balcony, the thing reviews love most
Rooftop infinity pool + RISE Rooftop Bar with Doi Suthep views
Nimman Soi 9 location, walk to Nimman Road and the famous cafes (from the reviews)
cons: The highest price on the list, starting around ฿4,500/night
Only 30 rooms, fills fast in high season so book ahead
The Nimman area is lively at night, ask to switch a street-facing room to an inward one

entries.name: Art Mai Gallery Nimman Hotel Chiang Mai by Compass Hospitality
entries.badge: 🎨 each floor an art theme · rooftop pool
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nimman Soi 3 · walk to One Nimman and Nimman Road
entries.addr: 21 Nimmana Haeminda Road Lane 3, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Art Mai Gallery Nimman is the stay for people who want a fresh, different experience at a reachable price · it's a 5-star art boutique in the Compass Hospitality group where each floor is designed around a different art theme — pop art, impressionism, surrealism — the work of different contemporary Thai artists, from the ground-floor lobby all the way up to the rooftop pool · set on Nimman Soi 3, it's walking distance to One Nimman and Nimman Road · it scores 9.2 from 285 reviews, and the Premier Art rooms start around 30 sqm from about ฿2,000/night, which is excellent value for a 5-star art-themed room in the Nimman area.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask the front desk which theme each floor has, then request the floor that matches your style · if you're sensitive to noise, ask for a high floor or a room not facing the street, since it's near the lively area and under a flight path · and go up to have breakfast and take photos at the rooftop pool in the morning or evening for the city and Doi Suthep views.
pros: An art concept on every floor by Thai artists, fresh and unlike anywhere else
A 5-star room from around ฿2,000, excellent value for the level
Rooftop pool with city and Doi Suthep views · breakfast is well done
Nimman Soi 3 location, walk to One Nimman and cafes (from the reviews)
cons: Near the airport and the lively area, some rooms hear night or aircraft noise
The bold design may not suit people who prefer plain, minimal tones
Ask for a high floor or an inward-facing room if you're a light sleeper

entries.name: Sanae' Hotel Nimman
entries.badge: 🛋️ every room a 45–67 sqm suite · free parking
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Sukkasem · 3 min walk to One Nimman
entries.addr: 8/1 Soi Sukkasem, Nimmanahaeminda Rd, Su Thep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Sanae' Hotel Nimman wins people over on one thing first: how big the rooms are · every room is a large suite — there isn't a single small room. Even the smallest is around 45 sqm, while the garden-view Executive Suite stretches to 67 sqm, and every room has a living room clearly separated from the bed · it's tucked down Soi Sukkasem off Nimman Road, so it's quieter than you'd expect for being right in the area, about a 3 min walk to One Nimman and Michelin restaurants · it scores 9.0 from 292 reviews, has free parking that's hard to find in central Nimman, and staff earn praise for their attentiveness — best suited to couples, small families and longer stays.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a city-view room or a corner suite when booking, since some lower-floor rooms have no window · if you're driving, let the hotel know in advance, since the free parking is limited · and if your budget can stretch, upgrading to a corner or Executive suite is often better value than you'd think.
pros: Very spacious rooms — every room is a 45–67 sqm suite with a separate living room
Central Nimman location, 3 min walk to One Nimman and Michelin restaurants
Free parking in central Nimman, very rare, ideal if you're driving
Attentive staff who help with problems and return left-behind items (from the reviews)
cons: Parts of the building and fittings are starting to age, the bathtubs are small
The pool is small and the water is cold, better for cooling off than real swimming
Some lower-floor rooms have no window or an unobstructed view

entries.type: Adults Only design hotel · quiet lane
entries.name: BED Nimman - Adults Only
entries.badge: 🛏️ Adults Only · saltwater pool · lots of freebies
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Siri Mangkalajarn Road · quiet lane next to Nimman
entries.addr: 20 Siri Mangkalajarn Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: BED Nimman - Adults Only is the answer for people who want private peace and quiet and a central Nimman location at the same time · it's a design hotel in the BED Hotels group, opened in 2015 and renovated in 2024, in a clean, modern minimalist style with 56 rooms, set on Siri Mangkalajarn Road down a quiet lane a few minutes' walk from Nimman Road · the whole hotel is adults-only, so there are no children running around, making it a fit for couples · what's praised most is beds so comfortable they live up to the BED brand name, and staff who look after guests so well the service score is high · there's an outdoor saltwater pool, plenty of freebies including a free minibar and all-day coffee, and free parking, scoring 9.0 from 261 reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a 2024-renovated room at the time of booking to avoid the rooms that are starting to age · if you're a sensitive or light sleeper, bring earplugs, since soundproofing between rooms isn't tight · and make the most of the freebies — both the minibar and the all-day coffee.
pros: Adults Only down a quiet lane, calm atmosphere with no children's noise
Comfortable beds living up to the BED brand · attentive staff with a high service score
Plenty of freebies, free minibar, all-day water and coffee, fresh breakfast
Skin-friendly saltwater pool, free parking, walking distance to Nimman Road
cons: Soundproofing between rooms isn't great, you sometimes hear the room next door
Some rooms have a musty smell or minor plumbing issues, ask for a 2024-renovated room
Young children can't stay · no rooftop pool or in-house spa

entries.name: Hotel Yayee
entries.badge: 🍸 rooftop bar with Doi Suthep views · Ananda's boutique
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nimman Soi 17 · walk to MAYA and Nimman Road
tags: 🍸 rooftop bar with Doi Suthep views
entries.addr: 17/5 Sai Nam Phueng Road (Nimman Soi 17), Tambon Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Hotel Yayee is a small adults-only boutique of just 14 rooms owned by actor Ananda Everingham, set on Nimman Soi 17, tastefully decorated and full of character · what gives it a charm different from other boutiques in the area is The Rooftop Bar on the 5th floor, where you sip signature cocktails looking out at Doi Suthep, the city skyline and planes coming in to land, which many reviews call the highlight · it sits down a lane deep enough to be quiet, but it's a few minutes' walk to MAYA, Nimman Road and the well-known cafes · rooms are clean with parquet floors and comfortable beds, there's free parking, and at 9.1 it's the highest score among the small boutiques — a fit for couples who want a boutique with real character.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: book ahead, because with only 14 rooms it fills fast, especially in high season · if size and the view matter to you, choose the Cozy Suite Full View over an Economy · and go up for a cocktail on the rooftop bar at sunset at least one evening for the Doi Suthep view.
pros: Highest score among the small boutiques at 9.1 · tastefully decorated, Ananda's boutique
Its own rooftop cocktail bar with Doi Suthep views and planes coming in to land
Sits down a lane deep enough to be quiet, but within walking distance of MAYA and Nimman Road
Clean rooms, comfortable beds, parquet floors, free parking (from the reviews)
cons: Soundproofing between rooms and from the bar still isn't tight, some rooms are smaller than standard
Some rooms hear aircraft in the early morning · bar food is small in portion and pricey
Adults Only, not ideal for families with young children · no pool or fitness room

entries.type: Design hotel 4★ · rooftop pool · great value
entries.name: Stay With Nimman
entries.badge: 🏊 2 rooftop pools · the most reviews on this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Siri Mangkalajarn Road · walk to One Nimman and MAYA
entries.addr: 8/8 Siri Mangkalajarn Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Stay With Nimman is a popular pick for anyone who wants a rooftop pool and a central location in the hip area for a four-figure baht budget · it's a 133-room design hotel on Siri Mangkalajarn Road, a few minutes' walk to One Nimman and MAYA, surrounded by cafes, galleries and restaurants all over Nimman · what many people choose it for is its two rooftop pools plus a fitness room and spa, which you don't often find at this price · what makes it trustworthy is that it has 2,059 reviews, the most on this list, and a 8.9 score reflecting that it's been proven by a large number of guests · Superior rooms start around ฿1,200/night, great value for the facilities you get.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a high-floor inward-facing room away from the street, which is quieter and cuts the bar and street noise in Nimman at night · head up to the rooftop pool at sunset to see Doi Suthep as a backdrop · and use the location to explore One Nimman and MAYA on foot without calling a car.
pros: 2 rooftop pools + fitness + spa, hard to find at a four-figure baht price
As many as 2,059 reviews, the most on this list, proven by a large number of guests
Central Nimman location, walk to One Nimman and MAYA
Spacious, modern-style rooms from around ฿1,200/night, great value (from the reviews)
cons: Rooms facing the street or the bar hear night noise, ask for a high-floor inward room
It's a big hotel, so service and the pools can get crowded when it's busy
Some fittings are starting to age from heavy use

entries.type: Design hotel 4★ · Chang Phueak · near MAYA
entries.name: The Core Gallery Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Huay Kaew Road · Chang Phueak · near MAYA and Chiang Mai University
entries.addr: 99/64, 99/105-107 Moo 1 Huay Kaew Road, Chang Phueak, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: The Core Gallery Hotel (which many people also call The Core Chiang Mai) is a 4-star design hotel in a white minimalist style mixed with street art on the walls, in the Chang Phueak area on Huay Kaew Road, near both MAYA and Chiang Mai University · opened in 2015 and renovated in 2024, it has 54 clean, white-toned rooms, many with a balcony and some with a kitchenette good for longer stays, plus an outdoor pool · it scores 9.0 from real reviews and starts around ฿1,200/night — a fit for people who want a good-looking stay with a pool for a four-figure baht budget and don't mind stepping just off the main Nimman axis for more quiet and better value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: pin the map and call the front desk when you arrive, since the hotel is set back in a lane with a small sign and is tricky to find the first time · ask for a high-floor room facing outward if you like natural light · and for a longer stay, choose a room with a kitchenette and specify it when booking.
pros: Minimal + street art design, renovated 2024, clean and good-looking rooms
An outdoor pool for a four-figure baht budget
A kitchenette in some rooms, good for longer stays or remote work
Near MAYA and Chiang Mai University, walk to the mall (from the reviews)
cons: In the Chang Phueak area, a bit further to walk to the main Nimman axis
The hotel is set back in a lane with a small sign, tricky to find the first time
Some lower or inward-facing rooms get little light · breakfast is simple

entries.type: Garden boutique 3★ · Chang Phueak · near Nimman
entries.name: Yellow Pillow Village
entries.badge: 🌿 garden house with a pool · high-ceilinged Loft rooms
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chang Phueak · a few minutes' drive to Nimman
entries.addr: 131/19 Ban Phae Soi 3, Chang Phueak, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Yellow Pillow Village is a small boutique of just 18 rooms in the Chang Phueak area, a pale-yellow house wrapped in a green garden with a small pool in the middle, the kind of place people stumble on by chance and come back to · it's not a luxury hotel and there's no grand lobby, but what reviews love is rooms bigger than their price, especially the Japanese-style pool-view rooms and the high-ceilinged, two-storey Family Loft · it's near Nimman, Wat Jed Yod and Chiang Mai University, a few minutes' drive away, with free parking, starting around ฿750/night — a fit for families and anyone who wants garden quiet on a light budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you're worried about noise, choose one of the high-ceilinged Loft rooms, which are clearly better soundproofed than the ground-floor Deluxe · breakfast is simple, but the Chang Phueak–Nimman area has plenty of good cafes a few minutes' drive away · and a car or Grab is easiest, since it's down a lane.
pros: Rooms bigger than their price, especially the Japanese pool-view rooms and two-storey Family Loft
A garden house with a pool, quiet and leafy atmosphere
Starts around ฿750/night, great value, with free parking
Near Nimman, Wat Jed Yod and CMU, a few minutes' drive (from the reviews)
cons: In the Chang Phueak area down a lane, not walking distance to Nimman, you need a car or Grab
The ground-floor Deluxe rooms aren't as well soundproofed as the Loft rooms
Breakfast is simple · it's a small stay without full facilities

entries.type: Hostel 2★ · in-house cafe · next to One Nimman
entries.name: Bed Addict Hostel x Cafe
entries.badge: 🎒 lightest budget · blackout-curtain bunks · in-house cafe
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nimmanhaemin Road · next to One Nimman and MAYA
entries.addr: 6/11 Nimmanhemin Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Bed Addict Hostel x Cafe is the answer for backpackers and digital nomads who want to stay in the heart of Nimman on a few-hundred-baht budget · it's a hostel set right next to One Nimman and MAYA, a few steps out the door, surrounded by the liveliest cafe and restaurant area in Chiang Mai · what reviews talk about most is the location within walking distance of everything, the cleanliness, the dorm bunks with blackout curtains that shut out the light completely with a reading light, power outlet and locker, and the cafe's genuinely good freshly roasted coffee · it starts at just ฿420/night for a dorm bunk yet scores a high 8.9 from 339 reviews, a fit for budget travellers who still want the area's best location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you're a quick sleeper, bring earplugs, since the Nimman area is lively some nights · use the in-house cafe as a place to work, since the Wi-Fi is fast · and choose a female-only dorm if you want a bit more privacy.
pros: Lightest budget on the list, from ฿420/night, yet scoring 8.9 from 339 reviews
Right next to One Nimman and MAYA, walk to the cafe street
Blackout-curtain dorm bunks that shut out the light, with light, outlet and locker, easy sleep
In-house coffee cafe, fast Wi-Fi good for digital nomads (from the reviews)
cons: Some nights have noise from the lively Nimman area, quick sleepers should bring earplugs
Shared dorms with a shared bathroom, little privacy
Small building, compact common areas · no pool or spa

adviceTitle: How do you pick a Nimman stay that fits your trip?

advice.head: Want the best location, walk the whole area
advice.bodyHtml: → U Nimman Chiang Mai ฿2,800, next to One Nimman, 24-hour stay, rooftop infinity pool, score 9.3, the highest on the list

advice.head: A design lover, wanting a luxury boutique or an art-themed room
advice.bodyHtml: → Akyra Manor ฿4,500, a 5-star SLH boutique with a balcony bathtub and infinity pool · or Art Mai Gallery ฿2,000, an art boutique with a different art theme on every floor, a 5-star room at great value

advice.head: Want a spacious room for a longer stay
advice.bodyHtml: → Sanae' Hotel Nimman ฿2,000, all-suite 45–67 sqm with a separate living room and free parking, 3 min walk to One Nimman

advice.head: A couples' trip, wanting private quiet
advice.bodyHtml: → BED Nimman - Adults Only ฿2,000, adults-only down a quiet lane, comfortable beds, saltwater pool · or Hotel Yayee ฿1,100, a small boutique with a rooftop bar and Doi Suthep views

advice.head: Want a pool for a four-figure baht budget
advice.bodyHtml: → Stay With Nimman ฿1,200, 2 rooftop pools with a fitness room and spa, the most reviews · or The Core Gallery ฿1,200, a design hotel with a pool in the Chang Phueak area near MAYA

advice.head: Light budget, focused on value and a good atmosphere
advice.bodyHtml: → Yellow Pillow Village ฿750, a garden house with a pool and spacious rooms near Nimman · or Bed Addict Hostel ฿420, blackout-curtain dorm bunks with an in-house cafe, next to One Nimman

advice.head: Driving yourself, need free parking
advice.bodyHtml: → Sanae' Hotel Nimman, BED Nimman, Hotel Yayee and Yellow Pillow Village — all have free parking, which is hard to find in central Nimman

noteHtml: 📌 Note: all prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room range and may change by date and season — we recommend checking real prices and comparing 3 sites before every booking · the scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms · most of the stays are in the Nimman area within walking distance of One Nimman and Maya, while The Core Gallery and Yellow Pillow Village are in the adjoining Chang Phueak area, where we recommend having a car or using Grab · many Nimman stays sit under a flight path and in a nightlife area that's lively after dark, so if you're a light sleeper we suggest asking for a high floor or an inward-facing room and bringing earplugs · during festivals (Yi Peng/Loy Krathong in Nov, Songkran 13–15 Apr, New Year) prices rise and rooms fill fast, so book 1–2 months ahead · Chiang Mai has no metro; the Nimman area is walkable, and a Grab or red truck is easy, with the airport about 10–15 min from Nimman · article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travellers often ask about staying in Nimman, Chiang Mai

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best stay in the Nimmanhaemin area?
faq.a: It depends on your budget and style · measured on location and score, U Nimman Chiang Mai at 9.3, next to One Nimman, is the best among the hotels · for luxury design, choose Akyra Manor, a 5-star SLH boutique, or Art Mai Gallery, an art boutique at great value · if you want a spacious room, Sanae' Hotel Nimman with all-suite 45–67 sqm · a couples' trip focused on quiet, BED Nimman Adults Only · on a few-hundred-baht budget, Bed Addict Hostel from ฿420, score 8.9

faq.q: ❓ How much do Nimman stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at around ฿420–4,500 per night · on the light-budget side, Bed Addict Hostel from ฿420 (dorm) and Yellow Pillow Village ฿750 · mid-range is Hotel Yayee ฿1,100, Stay With Nimman and The Core ฿1,200 · on the boutique side, Art Mai/Sanae'/BED ฿2,000, U Nimman ฿2,800 · and the top luxury boutique is Akyra Manor from ฿4,500 · all prices are approximate starting rates from standard rooms, and may be higher during festivals

faq.q: ❓ Can you really walk to One Nimman and MAYA from Nimman stays?
faq.a: Yes, from almost every one in this article · U Nimman and Bed Addict Hostel are right next to One Nimman · Art Mai (Soi 3), Sanae' (a 3 min walk) and Stay With Nimman are within walking distance of One Nimman · Hotel Yayee (Soi 17) and Akyra (Soi 9) are walking distance to Nimman Road · while The Core Gallery and Yellow Pillow Village are in the adjoining Chang Phueak area, where we recommend having a car or using Grab, a few minutes into Nimman

faq.q: ❓ Is the Nimman area noisy · what kind of room should I ask for?
faq.a: The Nimman area is lively all night, with bars, motorbikes and people throughout, and it's under a flight path so there's some aircraft noise during the day · many stays on this list have reviews agreeing that soundproofing between rooms still isn't tight · if you're a light sleeper, we recommend asking for a high floor or an inward-facing room that doesn't face the street at the time of booking, and bringing earplugs · if you want the most quiet, try the ones down a deep lane like BED Nimman and Sanae', or in the Chang Phueak area like The Core and Yellow Pillow

faq.q: ❓ Which Nimman stays suit couples and people wanting quiet?
faq.a: BED Nimman - Adults Only stands out most for this, adults-only down a quiet lane with comfortable beds · Hotel Yayee, a small adults-only boutique of 14 rooms with a rooftop bar and Doi Suthep views · Akyra Manor, a luxury boutique with a bathtub on a private balcony · and Sanae' sits down a deep lane, quieter than the roadside hotels, a fit for couples who want a spacious room

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Nimman stay?
faq.a: Several stays in this article are small boutiques (some with just 14–30 rooms, like Hotel Yayee and Akyra Manor), so they fill fast · during high season (November–February) and the Yi Peng/Loy Krathong festival, book 1–2 months ahead, especially Hotel Yayee, Akyra and Yellow Pillow, which have few rooms · at other times 3–4 weeks is enough · every platform offers Free Cancellation, so we recommend locking in a rate that way if your plans aren't fixed, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price

quickAnswerHtml: The Nimmanhaemin area has a stay in every style, all within walking distance of each other · for the best location, choose U Nimman, next to One Nimman, score 9.3 · for luxury design, choose Akyra Manor, 5-star, or Art Mai Gallery, an art boutique at great value · a couples' trip focused on quiet, choose BED Nimman Adults Only · on a light budget, choose Bed Addict Hostel from ฿420 · every one is within walking distance of One Nimman and MAYA.
